# ProtoFlow — truth vs derived

**`docs/*.md` are the single source of truth.** They are hand-editable, git-diffable, and BA-facing.

**`product-model.json`, `docs/INDEX.md`, `docs/board.yml`, `docs/spec.html`, `docs/interview.html`, `docs/interview-tree.html`, `prototype/`, `handoff/`, and `guides/` are derived.** They are regenerated by scanning the docs and must never be hand-edited — an edit to a derived file is lost on the next regeneration. (`guides/library.json` is refined by `/protoflow-guide` between the script's draft and the render, but only by that skill, never by hand.)

Data flows one direction only:

```
BA interview + materials/ → docs/ (truth) → derived artifacts (model, INDEX, board, spec.html) → prototype/ → handoff/ → guides/
```

To change anything, edit the docs and regenerate. Never edit a derived file to "fix" a number.
